extension.news: 2026-09-21 - Summary of v1.3.8 (see Tools > Changelog for the detail): * Simkl Authorise is AUTH V2 (device PIN). Existing V1 sign-ins keep working until you revoke and Authorise again * Simkl first sync stores activities so later list opens and mark watched do not full-pull the library again * My Simkl Lists when signed in with V2 (read-only; PRO/VIP for list contents; a free account gets a toast). Lists are movies, shows, or anime — anime opens as TV Shows, one page at a time * Track Rewatches (default off, Simkl PRO/VIP; a free account gets a toast and it turns back off) * Change Watched Indicators sits at the top of Account Settings * In Progress / resume can record on streams that report no duration (Trakt, Simkl, MDBList, and local bookmarks). Simkl / MDBList pause and stop wait until after CloseFile so they still land * Explore no longer ticks Simkl Plan to Watch; Watched / Up to Date parent ticks stay. A season ticks only when its episodes are watched, not after episode 1 * Simkl Trending, TVmaze, and TV Passport use Items Per Page * Changing Theme and pressing OK refreshes Tools so the new artwork shows immediately * My Simkl and My MDBList shelves use Items Per Page, same as My Trakt
